children: OCBC may benefit from rising benchmark rates in Singapore, RHB Research says in a note. If the Fed delivers two rate increases in October and December, the 3-month Singapore Overnight Rate Average could reach 1.50% by end-4Q, RHB says. Rising benchmark rates may provide Singapore banks like OCBC with another leg for growth in operating income. RHB Research raises its target price on the stock to 33.70 Singapore dollars from S$32.85 with an unchanged buy rating. Shares are 0.4% higher at S$31.68. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
